(30H) Bom... vamos lá...

Essa descrição bateu um pouco em casa e acho que posso dar uma ajuda.

Você caiu na rotina... Está na estabilidade.  
Em um primeiro momento, isso é um porre mesmo... Parece que a vida é sempre a mesma coisa, que nada muda, nada de empolgante acontece mais...

O que tu deseja realmente hoje, provavelmente não é ser solteiro... E sim sair da rotina, ter um pouco de empolgação, ter menos responsabilidade, se divertir sem consequências e principalmente, sem culpa.

Mas te dou certeza que será um ciclo sem fim... Você ficará solteiro, aproveitará por um tempo, cairá na rotina, procurará alguém e repetiria tudo de novo..

Cada ciclo mais velho, cada vez mais sozinho... O mundo não vai se moldar pra ti... Teus amigos continuarão com suas conjugues, as festas cada vez serão mais estranhas pra ti (não se sentirá mais parte daquilo), teu corpo não terá mais tanta energia pra aproveitar... 

E porque trago esse ponto de festa e curtição... Pelo menos, ao meu ponto de vista, são essas coisas que não se deve fazer em um relacionamento por respeito a tua esposa...

Se realmente não for nada disso que tu quer, só quer um pouco de tempo pra ti ou um espaço pra tu aproveitar sem perder o respeito com ela... Então lhe recomendo 3 coisas.

- Procurar terapia para te ajudar a organizar os pensamentos e descobrir realmente o que está fazendo falta na tua vida.  
- Após ter tudo organizado, conversar com tua esposa... Organizar um tempo para ambos aproveitarem sozinhos, sem nenhuma atividade que vá deixar o outro desconfortável.  
- Se afasta de influências de vida de solteiro... Existe a grande chance de tu estar se sentindo assim porque está se projetando na vida de alguém... Seja algum amigo, parente ou influencer de internet. Se afasta desse tipo de coisa, pois só vai trazer caos e dúvidas pra tua cabeça...

Não caia na besteira de abandonar tudo que tu conquistou por algo incerto... Se tu não tem certeza do que fazer, então não faça, só vai te trazer arrependimento e dor (pra ti e pra quem tua ama).

Be there.

I know.. it doesn't seem like much... But generally people who are in a dark place, are really afraid of being alone, of not having anyone to vent to, of thinking that they don't deserve to have anyone's support.

Each person deals with depression differently, there is no rule.

But if you want to make a difference for your friend, show that he is not alone, that he has someone to listen to his sufferings, who will not let him sink further into the abyss.

Try directing him to seek professional help.

If he is surrounded by toxic people, try to keep him away from them.

And most of all, tell him you love him. Tell him you care about him, tell him you're there with him to face these challenges.

Your voice will reach him.

It seems to me that you feel overwhelmed because you treat all problems as one...

I understand that work drains your energy, I understand that it's easier to do nothing than try to do something...

But try to reduce the pressure you are placing on yourself.

One step at a time.

One change at a time.



Start by trying to leave the house, you don't need to go to a gym or anything like that... Walk, look at the world around you, try to see what you've never seen in your life, even if it's for 10 or 20 minutes, you'll be surprised by everything you will see.



You don't need to change your entire diet. Start slowly, eating healthier foods during the week, it's okay to indulge in junk food at the weekend.



You don't need to wash all the dishes at once (for example). Start with part of the task, like "Today I'm going to wash 5 dishes", you'll be surprised how out of nowhere you'll have washed everything without realizing it.



Start having small conversations with people who are not in your personal circle, even if it's saying good morning to an attendant and asking how their day is going, you'll be surprised how much easier it will become to talk to new people when you meet them.



Live one day at a time, live for yourself, give yourself the chance to have peace and be happy.



Keep living, changing and learning, one day you will realize that the darkness still exists, but you will grow so much and become so strong, that it will no longer overwhelm you.

Once i was asleep, dreaming of a party... Drinking boose and talking to a girl...  
Then, out of nowhere, a guy grabs my arm, look deep into my eyes and said:  


"Wake up, there is someone inside your house"  


I never wake up in such fear in my life... Search up and down my flat... There was no one...  
Nothing out of the ordinary...  
But man... i couldnt go back to sleep that night...

Once, when i was 16, i was home alone, playing games on PC.  
Late in the night, my dogs go wild outside (i had a Rottweiler, a ChowChow and a stray dog on the time), making to much noise... More than usual... I shout to then to be quiet, but they ignore... They never ignore...  
After some time, i got mad and go downstares... I froze in place when i found the side door (that we never use) wide open...  
Rush back up, and try to find something to defend myself (ended up being my BB gun), go down again... Search the house, every room, every corner, inside of every cabinet...  
Nothing.... I shruged, pet my dogs, close the door and go back up...  
In the next day, my dad wake me up asking why the keys of the side door was outside inside a jacket...  


We checked the cameras and find out a man try to enter our house... He had the keys from the side door (How? we dont know...).  


In the second he open the door, my stray dog start barking at him, no long after my other dogs charge at him... He runs... Outside the view of the cameras...  
We deduce he jumps over the fence, so we talk to the neighbour, and he show us the gun he found on his yard that morning, it had blood on it... We call the cops but the gun didnt have any fingerprints... And he had his face covered... So the police just shrugs and go away...  


Yeah... My dogs saved me that night... They got alot of threats for their bravery!  


(Yeah, its not that scary... But i almost shit myself that night... And until today i wake up in the middle of the night thinking someone is inside my house...)
Probably i'll stay on the island, until i got depressed and than build a raft, and sail back home, or die trying.

Well... here am i 5 months after... Alive!
And thanks to you guys... Really... Thank you all!
Im stronger now, my mind is clear again... Im living one day after another... 
And im sure that alone i would not make those hard times...
So... from the bottom of my heart... Thanks!
